exposure: Internet use for information on vaginal breech birth
outcome: Themes and perceptions regarding vaginal breech birth expressed by pregnant women on online forums
cohort: Pregnant women participating in English language internet discussion forums about breech birth
finding: Pregnant women use online forums to seek information and support regarding vaginal breech birth, highlighting a need for clinicians to provide comprehensive and unbiased information to facilitate informed decision-making.
mod_finding: Women use online forums to gather information about vaginal breech birth to help make informed decisions about their birthing options.
